matches.quote: No spatially resolved field dependence is shown that would demonstrate the interior losing its signature before the edges. The claimed "spatial hierarchy" is not in the data.
The 1D wire and the waveguide were not mapped either, although they are the geometries that motivate the study.
The zero-field minimum, the key field signature, sits next to a feedback "glitch" at small negative field... Show Γ(B) for both sweep directions, to rule out hysteresis
The ~200 nm edge-channel claim rests on one line cut, at one boundary... The 1D wire and the waveguide were not mapped either
ε_r = 25 is a bulk literature value applied to a 4 uc film at 10 mK... Give uncertainties for Δn that include the choice of reference and ε_r.
The ~200 nm edge-channel claim rests on one line cut, at one boundary... Provide Γ maps across both edges of the 2D channel
The text says "both devices show Ic of 30 nA". The Fig. 1f line cut for Device A shows switching at about ±12 nA

The carrier-density calibration is underdetermined, yet the doping-dome assignment depends on absolute densities... Surface-dipole and protonation contributions, which the SI itself names as the mechanism behind writing, are neglected.
Report β/α as a spatial map, not at two points.
The tests that would isolate superconductivity are: ... field dependence at the reference point B. None is shown. The only field dependence is at point A
Without these, the claim that the ΔV⁴ term is "a robust local marker of superconductivity" (p. 9) is not supported.
The minimum therefore appears to sit on the unpatterned side of the boundary, which the text does not discuss.

notes: P3, P7, and P11 are section/verdict headers produced by point segmentation and are marked generic/minor. For C2, Fig. 4e's caption in v1 notes a feedback 'glitch' at small negative field; P15 flags this feature and asks for both field-sweep directions to check hysteresis/asymmetry, which is scored 'partly'. For C4, C5, and C6, the review raises closely related criticisms (unmapped 1D wire/other geometries in P5, position of the Fig. 5h dissipation minimum relative to the patterned boundary and dome doping levels in P5/P6, and requesting a spatial map of beta/alpha in P9) that would lead to the same fixes, so they are scored 'partly'.
